codemap:
Files the issue has to change (paths relative to repo root):
- src/evaluator/countIndex.js — builds the tally index and decides under which ids a roster selection is counted; today an entryLink selection also counts under its resolved target id, but the pinned gap is the mirror case (a selection carrying only the target id must satisfy a condition naming the root entryLink id), so the aliasing here is the prime suspect.
- src/evaluator/query.js — resolves a condition's scope/childId counting query (atLeast, scope=force) against the tally index; the other place the link-id/target-id lookup could land.
- src/evaluator/evalTree.js — binds roster selections to catalog definitions; a selection with empty entryLinkId binds via entryId, which is where a target-only selection gets its identity.
- src/evaluator/resolver.js — resolves entryLinks to their transitive targets; any link-to-target aliasing fix reads this relation.
- src/evaluator/ (new or extended unit test file) — the issue's scope explicitly allows unit tests beside the production fix; the researcher decides placement and name.

Read-only context, must NOT change (specification, out of scope):
- docs/testing/at-least-force-toggle-gate/ — the pinned scenario (.ros files, scenario.json, README.md) is the specification; roster 02-greasus-with-toggle-max1.ros is the failing case, roster 01 must stay green.
- docs/testing/campaign-state.json — pins the gap under pinnedGaps; outside src/evaluator/, not to be edited by this run.
- src/evaluator/e2e.testcatalog.test.js — the manifest-driven runner that executes the scenario; it is the judge, not the fix.

Check command for the whole issue: npx vitest run src/evaluator (per the issue's Decisions; the full npm test is not required for evaluator-only changes).

increments.title: Count target-id selections under a root entryLink childId in force-scoped conditions
increments.goal: An atLeast(field=selections, scope=force) condition whose childId names a root entryLink (9e50-7486-65ab-c449) also counts roster selections that carry only the link's resolved target id (entryId 8923-5946-7b10-8957, entryLinkId empty), so the set-1 modifier gated by it lifts Greasus's max-0 constraint (cef8-c3b1-7850-85bc) when the toggle is selected.
criteria: npx vitest run src/evaluator exits 0, including the previously failing case 'Szenario: at-least-force-toggle-gate > rosters/02-greasus-with-toggle-max1.ros' (Greasus slot reports effectiveMax 1, constraint cef8-c3b1-7850-85bc no longer fires) and the still-green sibling case rosters/01-greasus-without-toggle-max0.ros (effectiveMax 0, constraint fires at actual 1, bound 0).
All changes are confined to src/evaluator/ production code and its unit tests; no file under docs/testing/ is changed, weakened or deleted.

The behavior change is covered by an evaluator unit test if the researcher's test plan calls for one beyond the pinned E2E scenario; the E2E scenario itself is the specification and is exercised only through the existing manifest runner.

steps.label: decompose

return.summary: One increment, not a split: the issue pins exactly one behavior gap — an atLeast(scope=force) condition naming a root entryLink id must also count selections carrying only the link's resolved target id — and its single acceptance criterion lands whole in inc-1-atleast-force-link-target-alias, judged by the issue's own check command (npx vitest run src/evaluator) with both scenario rosters pinned in its criteria. Splitting production fix from unit tests or from the E2E-green state would leave a first half nobody can review as done. The codemap names the counting/aliasing chain (countIndex.js as prime suspect, query.js, evalTree.js, resolver.js) plus the read-only scenario spec under docs/testing/ that must not change; which file actually carries the fix is the researcher's call.
